01 — About

Building mobile products that hold up in production.

Muhammad Anas Khan is a Senior Flutter Developer and mobile architect based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, with over five years of experience designing, developing and deploying scalable Android, iOS and Web applications across automotive, enterprise, SaaS and e-commerce industries.

His work spans Clean Architecture, state management (Bloc, Provider, Riverpod, GetX), Firebase, REST APIs and AI integration — cutting development timelines by up to 40% and improving app performance by 30% across production releases on Google Play and the App Store.
